title: Academic Council meeting at K. Karasaev Bishkek State University

blocks.text: On 25 February 2026, the regular meeting of the Academic Council of Bishkek State University named after Academician Kusein Karasaev was held.

The council considered current issues concerning the university’s educational, research and organisational activities and adopted a number of important decisions on the agenda. Reports from structural units were also heard, and tasks for the upcoming period were defined.
